ambiguity.detail: Unclear how Alexander and Juliana went from strangers/low status to a confirmed couple.
Catherine appears suddenly in a bridal gown without prior context.

verdict.hook_line: Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A newly revealed Duke humiliates his former bride at the altar by declaring his true love is actually his loyal wife.
verdict.why_it_works: Explosive emotional payoff, high stakes betrayal, and a massive status reversal right at the start.
